{{Top|leg}}
An '''energy battery''' was a weapons emplacement composed of multiple [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. These arrays were used on [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and to protect ground installations.
